rationale_one_line: Warp's warm dark terminal-craftsman palette is the truest match for Jesse Vincent, a veteran who markets discipline like a lifestyle; CLASSIC frames the angle on an already-famous project instead of introducing it.
writing_tone_notes: Plain, dry, staff-engineer voice. Bold declaratives, contractions where natural, specifics over adjectives. Admiring through contrast, never superlatives. The campfire-ember accent (#E0913E) is the single warm glow in a warm near-black forest; use it sparingly on the one beat that matters per scene.
do_rules: Lead the loop diagram with the four enforced gates: clarify, plan, build, review.
Keep the warmth: warm parchment ink on warm charred near-black, one ember accent.
Let the contrast (vibe coding vs enforced method) carry the praise.
Use the veteran pedigree (RT, Perl, Keyboardio) only on the X caption, not in scenes.
dont_rules: No version numbers in the X caption.
No cold blue-black; warp is warm near-black, never austere.
Don't repeat 'plans' / 'discipline' / 'rules' phrasing verbatim across tweet, why-this-one, and scenes.
